name: megascenes-youtube-banner
description: Design a YouTube channel banner with your channel name and tagline in the 2560 x 1440 format, with the text in the central safe area.

interface.longDescription:
Give your channel name, a tagline and the look you want: gaming, cooking, travel, tech, minimal or bold. You get a banner in the 2560 x 1440 format with the text kept in the central area that shows on phones, computers and TVs.

ChatGPT tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The banner opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For new channels, rebrands, seasons and launches.

Limitations: your text is passed to the model as written and the lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result. It does not upload the banner to your channel. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design a channel banner with your name and tagline
Keep the text in the central safe area
Return the banner in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a YouTube banner for my cooking channel Spice Lab
Design a gaming channel banner for PixelRush with a neon look
Create a minimal travel channel banner with the tagline Go Further

positive.prompt: Which models can design a channel banner here?
positive.expected_behavior: The channel banner models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Design a YouTube banner for my cooking channel Spice Lab. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one banner with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which model is best for the text on a channel banner?
positive.expected_behavior: The models with their settings, to choose one for lettering. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Design a YouTube banner for my cooking channel Spice Lab with the tagline New recipes every Friday. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my channel banner on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my channel banner to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
